title: SlipX vehicle dynamics parameters
description: dynamics.yaml: mass, inertia, geometry, tyre references and drivetrain. This is the file slipx_id emits (P2) and the file a registry entry consists of. SI units throughout, no exceptions: metres, kilograms, seconds, radians, newtons. Every bound below is a physical or competition bound, and none of them is a default. Silent defaulting is prohibited (SCH-02), so every field the physics needs is required.

mass.description: Total mass, sprung plus unsprung, as the car is raced: battery in, bodyshell on. [kg] The upper bound is generous for the 1/10 class rather than a rule.

inertia.description: Inertia tensor about the CoG, in the body frame. [kg m^2] Only izz affects any tier below L3, but all three principal moments are required: an inertia tensor with a hole in it cannot be checked for physical consistency (SCH-04), and a value that is absent today gets guessed tomorrow.

geometry.description: Distances in metres, ISO 8855 frame: x forward, y left, z up.

lf.description: CoG to front axle, positive forward. [m]

lr.description: CoG to rear axle, positive rearward. [m]

track_front.description: Front track width, wheel centre to wheel centre. [m]

h_cog.description: CoG height above the ground plane. [m] No effect below L2, which has no mechanism to transfer load; that is deliberate (SRS 2.4).

wheel_radius.description: Effective rolling radius, loaded. Not the moulded radius. [m]

length.description: Overall length including bodywork. [m] Checked against the RoboRacer dimensional rules (SCH-03).

width.description: Overall width including bodywork. [m] Checked against the RoboRacer dimensional rules (SCH-03).

tyres.description: Tyres are REFERENCED, never embedded (SCH-05). A tyre is a (compound, surface) pair, because the same car on carpet and on polished concrete is two different vehicles. Embedding the coefficients in the car file is how asphalt numbers end up being used on a sports hall floor.

layout.description: Driven axles. The RoboRacer rules permit 2WD and 4WD (SCH-03).

differential.description: Differential type. Modelled from L2 (CORE-11, P1); below that it cannot affect the trajectory.

lsd_preload.description: Locking preload torque, required when differential is lsd. [N m]

resistance.description: Longitudinal resistance. Both terms are identifiable from a coastdown (ID-02), and both are needed: rolling resistance is speed-independent and drag goes as v^2, so a coastdown at one speed cannot separate them.

drag_coeff.description: 0.5 * rho * Cd * A. [kg/m] Close to negligible below about 15 m/s at 1/10 scale, and retained because coastdown fitting needs it, not because it changes lap times.

numerics.description: Not physics. Exposed because it changes the model and therefore belongs in the manifest hash (SIM-06) rather than hiding as a constant in the source.

v_eps.description: Speed floor used in slip-angle denominators, mitigating the single-track model's singularity at standstill. [m/s]

compound.description: Tyre compound, a community vocabulary since 0.4.0 (see tyre.schema.json). The RoboRacer rules permit sponge and rubber, and that legality check belongs to the registry and the competition, not the parser (SCH-03).

surface.description: The surface these coefficients were obtained on. Free text rather than an enum: surfaces are a community vocabulary and hard-coding a list would make a contributor's polished-concrete sports hall unrepresentable.
